$comment: Registry of the Ranger sources that declare a published API surface. gallery/office/docs/tools/extract-api.mjs reads this file and writes gallery/office/docs/.model/*-api.json; render-reference.mjs turns that into the pages published at /office/reference/. It lives here rather than under docs/ because the pages quote AGPL comments and the documentation site is MIT. A facade added to gallery/*/api/ and not listed here is documented nowhere, which check-api-coverage.mjs reports.

apis.title: PowerPoint
apis.summary: Open a .pptx, read it, change it, write it back — draw it to PNG or PDF, and put a Vega chart on it as shapes.

entries.title: The document
entries.summary: Headless: a ZIP reader, an XML parser, the model and the writer. No canvas and no fonts.

js.$comment: How each Ranger class and accessor appears in the JavaScript package. The reference is generated from the Ranger comments because that is where the prose lives, but a reader installs @ranger/pptx and must see the names THEY will type. docs:api:coverage fails when a documented method has no counterpart in the wrapper.

entries.title: Drawing
entries.summary: PNG and PDF. A separate entry point because its bundle is five times the size.

entries.title: Charts
entries.summary: A Vega or Vega-Lite specification onto a slide, as DrawingML shapes rather than as a picture.
